trained_on: 100% of labeled data (no held-out fold), same recipe as Model A/B's own servable fit (ml.evaluate.XGB_PARAMS, seed 42, no scale_pos_weight -- confirmed from their own metadata, not assumed) -- see validated_performance for the honest expected-performance estimate, from ml/experiments/ablation/'s drop_all_identity_and_age (grouped 5-fold CV x 3 seeds, same recipe).
threshold_method: 99th percentile of OUT-OF-FOLD scores from a grouped 5-fold CV (same seed, same recipe as validated_performance) -- deliberately NOT the in-sample method Model A and Model B use (99th percentile of the final 100%-fit model's own scores over its own training negatives). Model A and Model B are unchanged; this is a one-off difference for Model C, not a retroactive fix applied to them.
